title: job.liquidate (v1)
description: Command to the live-worker running a deployment: liquidate every holding (LEAN `LiquidateCommand`, delivered to the engine through its command handler) and keep the algorithm running. Published by job-orchestrator to `lean.control` with routing key `job.<jobId>.liquidate.v1`, AMQP type `control.v1.LiquidateJob`, persistent. A worker whose `leaseEpoch` is newer than the one named ignores it.

attempt.description: Attempt holding the lease when the command was sent.
